info.name: FRED Categories API
info.description:
Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) API — the public web service operated by the Research Division of the Federal Reserve Bank of St.

Contact Support:
 Name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis — Research Division

item.name: FRED Get the Child Categories for a Category

query.description: (Required) 32-character lower-case alphanumeric FRED API key.
Response format. xml (default) or json. The observations endpoint additionally accepts xlsx and csv.
(Required) Parent category ID.
Start of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.
End of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

item.name: FRED Get the Series in a Category

query.description: (Required) 32-character lower-case alphanumeric FRED API key.
Response format. xml (default) or json. The observations endpoint additionally accepts xlsx and csv.
(Required) The category to enumerate.
Start of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.
End of the real-time period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.
Maximum number of results to return (1–1000).
Non-negative integer offset into the result set for pagination.
Field to order series results by.
Sort order. asc (ascending, default) or desc (descending).
Attribute to filter series results by.
Value of the filter_variable attribute to match.
Semicolon-separated list of tag names to require.
Semicolon-separated list of tag names to exclude.
